title: angraecopsis stellata
intro: Angraecopsis stellata, commonly known as the star angraecopsis, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is known for its unique star-shaped flowers and is often used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, providing therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Angraecopsis stellata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
